description: TXN-FLUSH-BEHIND, what ends the window (the first card had one kill sample each for Idle and Close). Three implicit INSERT...SELECT runs on the big fixture, each followed at once by one action and the file read right after and every 50 ms for 300 ms: (1) DBEngine.Idle(dbRefreshCache); (2) DBEngine.Idle(dbFreeLocks, 1); (3) a Recordset open/close on a small snapshot. Then a fourth run followed by Database.Close and the file reads. Asks which call makes the file image change at once and which leave it to the timer.
retentionNote: Designed R-TXN-1 TXN-FLUSH probe of the second follow-up card (r-q2-cat-txn-lock); complete capture of the ACE answer. One kept database image is larger than 100 MB and is kept in evidence/artifacts-large/ on the oracle machine, outside git.
